c1a_hces_nas_ratio.description: HCES-scale spending vs SUT PFCE by product and commodity (the H1 gap)

c4a_imputed_rent_sensitivity.description: C4a imputed rent: SAM prior (HCES 539) vs the AIDIS building-value rural/urban split (band)

c4b_fisim_split_sensitivity.description: C4b household FISIM by group: SAM prior (XR-5 split) vs stock weights, loans excluding HFC housing loans, and deposits only (V-HH-3; memo for Checkpoint B)

c4c_npish_memo.description: C4c memo: NPISH final consumption share (OECD ICIO 2022-23); NPISH stays embedded in PFCE

hh_aidis_overlap.description: AIDIS 2019 household-expenditure quintile classes -> SAM groups: overlapping households (HCES 2023-24) and weights

hh_group_map.description: HCES 2023-24 fractile classes -> SAM household groups: persons, households, avg MPCE

hh_hces_items.description: HCES 2023-24 item spending by SAM group, Rs crore/yr at HCES scale (leaf items, 539, totals)

hh_keys.description: Reusable household keys by SAM group (levels and shares = level / sum of levels; consumers should normalise the levels): population, HCES spending, this block's PFCE, C4a and C4b components, AIDIS 2019 asset and debt keys, FISIM parameters. aidis_equity / aidis_mf / aidis_small_savings equal aidis_fin_assets (no asset-class split exists in the ingested AIDIS tables); life insurance: use aidis_fin_assets; non-life premiums: use c4b_insurance_service (HCES 2023-24 has no insurance-premium item).

hh_national_quintile_xwalk.description: Persons of each SAM group by national (rural+urban) MPCE person quintile q1..q5, and the estimated national cut-offs (Rs per person per 30 days)

hh_state_xwalk.description: HCES 2023-24 State x area x State fractile class -> SAM groups (all-India area quintiles): weights, persons and consumption (Rs crore/yr, HCES scale)

s8_food_stik.description: S8: free PDS rice and wheat by SAM group (tonnes; Rs crore at the SUT GFCE unit value) and memo rows (other free items; HCES-valued grain)
